overview: A full-featured online job service portal where job seekers can search, filter, and apply for jobs, and employers can post openings, manage listings, and review applicants — all backed by a Motoko canister on the Internet Computer.
features: Job search by title, keyword, and location
Filtered job listings (category, location, job type, salary range)
Job detail pages with full description and Apply button
Dual-role authentication: Job Seeker and Employer
Employer job posting form and management dashboard
Job seeker profile with skills, experience, and education
Employer applicant review with Accept/Reject actions
Featured and recent jobs on the home page
Category section (IT, Healthcare, Finance, Education, Engineering, etc.)
